scope: Documented Baba-Peranakan food heritage with explicit Takua Pa inclusion; Takua Pa tao sor; cultural market. Not interviews, a store ranking, or proof every regional Baba dish originated or is currently sold in Takua Pa.
confidence: High for official registry inclusion, published pastry descriptions and dated FDA award; medium for general cultural synthesis; current schedules and founders unknown.

contradictions_and_gaps: No confirmed substantive contradiction in selected food claims. Independence is at institutional-document level, not two sources for every single claim.
Do not turn 17 Dec 2017 market directory foundation/promotion field into definitive first-ever cultural market date without historical organizer records.

SAC community article https://wikicommunity.sac.or.th/community/951 is useful discovery/context but cites mixed theses, commercial travel and blogs. Not selected as primary evidence for chronology or Baba food origin.
No maker interviewed; no claim of site visit, tasting, family recipe age, current price, stock or availability.
Regional DCP examples of ceremonial foods are not evidence of Takua Pa-specific practice without further local field material.
Potential article should interleave 9 limited supported claims with editorial questions and useful navigation, not pad length with unverified origin legends.
recommended_article_structure: Opening: food as an entry into a living city, with explicit Takua Pa membership in Baba heritage network.
National registry context and family transmission; distinguish regional context from local observations.
Tao sor section: verified description and dated first-party Tuang Rat example without invented maker quotes.
Market section: verified road location and cultural/food mix, link to map and food directory.
Reader action: ask maker about filling and recipe, request photo permission, confirm market timetable with organizer; label suggestions as suggestions.
Sources and editorial note: research date, documentary basis, no interviews yet.
copyright_note: Evidence snippets deliberately very short; final article should paraphrase concisely, cite direct sources, and stay within source-specific summarization budgets.
